汤姆上幼儿园
兔子汤姆
成长的烦恼图画书
心理自助读物
海燕出版社 MANGO JEUNESSE

[P2] 兔子汤姆
成长的烦恼与智慧
心理自助读物
汤姆上幼儿园
[法]玛丽·阿利娜·巴文／图  [法]克斯多夫·勒·马斯尼／文  梅莉／译
海燕出版社
MANGO JEUNESSE

[P3] 爸爸妈妈告诉我，在幼儿园我会有一个很好的老师。可是，他们并不认识我的老师啊！

[P4] 明天，是我上幼儿园的第一天。我想，我在幼儿园能干些什么呢？我一点儿都不高兴。

[P5] 妈妈给我买了一支铅笔、一块橡皮和一盒水彩笔。

[P6] 还有一个漂亮的双肩书包。我特别喜欢用鼻子闻书包，新书包的味道真好闻！

[P7] 晚上，我和妈妈一起准备好我上幼儿园的东西。“妈妈，我觉得我好像生病了，不能上幼儿园了。”

[P8] 妈妈给我量了量体温，对我说，我根本没有生病。我越来越不想明天就上幼儿园了。

[P9] 现在，我要和爸爸说晚安了。“上幼儿园，多好啊！”爸爸对我说，“你会学到很多又新奇又好玩的东西。”

[P10] 躺在床上，我对妈妈说，能不能让幼儿园的老师带着所有的同学来我们家，到我的房间？……而妈妈只是微笑地看着我，什么也没说，还使劲地亲了我一下。

[P11] 我睡不着，就坐在床上看月亮，我真害怕明天上幼儿园。

[P12] “起床，该起床了。”妈妈轻轻地对我说。啊，已经到早上了！
我好像刚刚睡着。

[P13] 吃早饭的时候，我心里挺难受的。但是，我要勇敢，我不能哭。

[P14] 大街上，有许多第一天上幼儿园的孩子，由父母陪着，他们都忍住不哭。

[P15] 但是，在幼儿园门口，真是太难和妈妈分开了……

[P16] “拿着这个。”妈妈给我一块手绢，“在你伤心的时候，就看看手绢，想想妈妈。”

[P17] 老师来接我们了，她看上去很和善。走进大楼里的时候，我紧紧地抓着妈妈的手绢。

[P18] 我们走进了一个干净整洁的房间。老师说，这是我们的教室。我看了看玩具和墙上的画，我真喜欢。

[P19] 我的同桌叫路路。他好像不高兴待在这里，因为他不停地哭。

[P20] 我想安慰他，就把妈妈的手绢给他，让他擦了擦眼泪。

[P21] 上午，老师教我们画画和剪纸，还唱歌。

[P22] 课间休息的时候，我同路路一起玩扔皮球，真开心啊！

[P23] 午睡后，老师用手偶给我们讲故事。

[P24] 铃声响了，幼儿园的一天结束了。这么快！我都没有感觉到。

[P25] 放学了，妈妈在幼儿园门口等我。见到妈妈，我很高兴。我盼着明天快点儿到来，我要和路路一起玩，还要画完我的画。

[P26] 著作权合同登记号：图字 16-2007-66

专家导读

汤姆要上幼儿园了，第一次上幼儿园对他来说真是一个前所未有的大挑战。这本书告诉你，孩子是如何体验上幼儿园这件事的。为什么有些孩子会装病、耍赖、在幼儿园门口拉着妈妈不松手……要知道，对孩子来说，上幼儿园是一件多么不容易的事啊。让我们给这些孩子宽容、鼓励以及爱的拥抱吧，相信他们会和汤姆一样喜欢上幼儿园的。

——华东师范大学学前教育研究所朱家雄、胡慧慧

[P1] [Fr.] Marie-Aline Bava / ill. [Fr.] Christophe Léonard / text Mei Li / trans.
Tom Goes to Kindergarten
Rabbit Tom
Growth Troubles Picture Book
Psychological Self-Help Reading
Haiyan Publishing House MANGO JEUNESSE

[P2] Tom the Rabbit
Growing Up: Troubles and Wisdom
Psychological Self-Help Book
Tom Goes to Kindergarten
[France] Marie-Aline Bava / Illustrations  [France] Christophe L. Masni / Text  Mei Li / Translator
Haiyan Publishing House
MANGO JEUNESSE

[P3] Mom and Dad told me I would have a very good teacher at kindergarten. But, they don't know my teacher!

[P4] Tomorrow is my first day at kindergarten. I wonder, what can I do at kindergarten? I'm not happy at all.

[P5] Mom bought me a pencil, an eraser, and a box of watercolor pens.

[P6] There's also a beautiful backpack. I especially like to smell it with my nose—the smell of a new backpack is so nice!

[P7] In the evening, I and my mom prepared everything I needed for kindergarten. "Mom, I feel like I'm sick. I can't go to kindergarten."

[P8] Mom measured my temperature and told me, 'You're not sick at all.' I was getting more and more reluctant to go to kindergarten tomorrow.

[P9] Now, I'm going to say goodnight to Dad. 'Going to kindergarten is so great!' Dad said to me, 'You'll learn many new and fun things.'

[P10] Lying in bed, I said to Mom, 'Could the kindergarten teacher bring all the classmates to our house, to my room?' ... Mom just smiled at me, said nothing, and gave me a firm kiss.

[P11] I can't sleep, so I sit on the bed looking at the moon. I'm really afraid of going to kindergarten tomorrow.

[P12] "Wake up, time to get up," Mom said softly to me. Ah, it's already morning!
I feel like I just fell asleep.

[P13] While eating breakfast, I felt really upset inside. But I have to be brave. I can't cry.

[P14] On the street, there are many children on their first day of kindergarten, accompanied by their parents. They all hold back their tears.

[P15] But at the kindergarten gate, it was really hard to say goodbye to Mom...

[P16] "Here, take this." Mom gave me a handkerchief. "When you feel sad, look at the handkerchief and think of Mom."

[P17] The teacher came to pick us up. She looked very kind. When we walked into the building, I held tightly onto my mom's handkerchief.

[P18] We walked into a clean and tidy room. The teacher said, 'This is our classroom.' I looked at the toys and the pictures on the wall. I really like it.

[P19] My desk mate is called LuLu. He seems unhappy to be here, because he keeps crying.

[P20] I wanted to comfort him, so I gave him Mom's handkerchief and let him wipe his tears.

[P21] In the morning, the teacher taught us to draw, cut paper, and sing songs.

[P22] During the break, I played catch with Lulu. How happy I was!

[P23] After nap time, the teacher told us a story using puppets.

[P24] The bell rang. The day at kindergarten is over. So fast! I didn't even notice.

[P25] School is over, and Mom is waiting for me at the kindergarten gate. Seeing Mom, I am very happy. I look forward to tomorrow coming soon, so I can play with Lulu and finish my drawing.

[P26] Copyright Contract Registration No.: Figure 16-2007-66

Expert Introduction

Tom is going to kindergarten. Going to kindergarten for the first time is a huge challenge for him. This book tells you how children experience going to kindergarten. Why do some children pretend to be sick, act stubborn, or hold onto their mothers at the kindergarten gate... You must know, for children, going to kindergarten is such a difficult thing. Let's give these children tolerance, encouragement, and loving hugs. We believe they will come to love kindergarten just like Tom.

— Zhu Jiaxiong, Hu Huihui, Early Childhood Education Research Institute, East China Normal University

full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《汤姆上幼儿园》的封面，展示了兔子老师在教室里给一群小兔子讲故事的场景，画面温馨，体现了幼儿园的集体活动氛围。
[P2] 本页为绘本《汤姆上幼儿园》的封面，展示了兔子老师蹲下与背着书包的小兔子汤姆握手的温馨场景，体现了幼儿园入学的主题。
[P3] 小兔子汤姆独自在沙坑里玩耍，心里想着爸爸妈妈告诉他幼儿园会有好老师，但自己并不认识老师，流露出一丝不安。
[P4] 小兔子汤姆在家中与父母共进晚餐，内心对即将开始的幼儿园生活感到不安和不开心。
[P5] 小兔子汤姆和妈妈在文具店，妈妈为他购买了铅笔、橡皮和水彩笔，为上幼儿园做准备。
[P6] 小兔子汤姆背着新书包，用鼻子闻着书包，表达了对新书包的喜爱和对幼儿园生活的期待。
[P7] 小兔子汤姆和妈妈一起准备上幼儿园的物品，但他感到不安，说自己好像生病了，不想去幼儿园。
[P8] 小兔子汤姆因不想上幼儿园而假装生病，妈妈为他量体温后发现他并未生病，他因此更加不想去幼儿园了。
[P9] 小兔子汤姆在家中与爸爸道晚安，爸爸鼓励他上幼儿园，告诉他会学到很多新奇又好玩的东西，试图缓解他的不安情绪。
[P10] 小兔子汤姆躺在床上，向妈妈提出希望幼儿园老师和同学来家里做客，妈妈微笑着亲了他一下，没有直接回应。
[P11] 小兔子汤姆睡不着，坐在床上望着窗外的月亮，内心充满对明天上幼儿园的恐惧。
[P12] 清晨，妈妈轻轻叫醒小兔子汤姆，他刚睡着不久，对即将开始的一天感到困倦和不情愿。
[P13] 小兔子汤姆在吃早餐时感到内心难受，但他告诉自己要勇敢，不能哭。
[P14] 大街上，许多孩子在父母的陪伴下第一天上幼儿园，尽管内心不舍，但都努力忍住不哭。
[P15] 小兔子汤姆在幼儿园门口依依不舍地和妈妈分开，内心充满不舍与难过。
[P16] 妈妈在幼儿园门口递给小兔子汤姆一块手绢，告诉他伤心时可以看看手绢，想想妈妈，以此给予他情感上的安慰和支持。
[P17] 小兔子汤姆在幼儿园门口与妈妈分开后，老师前来迎接孩子们，他紧紧抓着妈妈给的手绢，走进大楼，内心仍有些紧张。
[P18] 小兔子汤姆和同学们走进了干净整洁的幼儿园教室，老师向他们介绍这是教室，汤姆看到玩具和墙上的画后感到很喜欢。
[P19] 小兔子汤姆观察到他的同桌路路一直在哭，显得很不开心，汤姆对此有所察觉。
[P20] 小兔子汤姆看到同桌路路在哭，便把自己妈妈给的手绢递给他，想安慰他擦眼泪。
[P21] 上午，小兔子汤姆和同学们在幼儿园里画画、剪纸和唱歌，教室里充满欢乐的氛围。
[P22] 课间休息时，小兔子汤姆和同桌路路一起玩扔皮球，两人玩得很开心。
[P23] 午睡后，老师在教室里用手偶给小兔子们讲故事，孩子们围坐在一起认真听讲。
[P24] 幼儿园的一天结束了，铃声响起，小兔子汤姆感叹时间过得飞快，完全没有察觉到一天已经结束。
[P25] 幼儿园放学了，小兔子汤姆在门口见到妈妈，非常开心，并期待明天能和同桌路路一起玩，还要完成自己的画作。
[P26] 本页为绘本《汤姆上幼儿园》的版权页和专家导读，介绍了书籍内容和出版信息，强调了孩子入园适应的挑战，并呼吁给予孩子宽容与鼓励。
